title: Laurel Marquise Necklace
intro: Leaves of light around the neck. Clear marquise cut cubic zirconia, about 5 x 10mm each, are set on a slant in groups of three like leaves on a stem, each stone in its own four claw gold tone setting, and each cluster linked to the next.
tip: Wear it alone with an open neckline, or with small studs.
details: Stones: Marquise cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 5 x 10mm, in four claw settings
Pattern: Clusters of three stones set on a slant, linked one to the next
Width: Approximately 9mm
Length: Approximately 42cm (to confirm)
Metal: Gold tone

title: Soleil Petal Pendant
intro: A small sun at the throat. One round clear cubic zirconia of about 7mm sits up in six claws at the centre, and six slender polished gold tone petals curve out around it like a pinwheel, about 25mm across in all, on a fine snake chain.
tip: Let it sit alone on a plain neckline, so the petals catch the light.
details: Pendant: Approximately 25mm across, six polished petals
Stone: Round clear cubic zirconia, approximately 7mm, in a six claw setting
Chain: Fine snake chain with a lobster clasp and extender
Length: Approximately 42cm plus the extender (to confirm)
Metal: Gold tone

title: Pearl Crescent Pendant
intro: A pearl held by a new moon. One round white shell pearl of about 10mm sits in a small gold tone cup, with a slim crescent of small clear cubic zirconia curving around one side of it, on a fine box chain with a sliding bead.
tip: Slide the bead to wear it high at the collarbone or lower on a V neck.
details: Pearl: Round white shell pearl, approximately 10mm
Pearl source: Shell pearl, provenance not stated by the supplier
Stones: Small round clear cubic zirconia, approximately 2mm, in a crescent
Chain: Fine box chain with an adjustable sliding bead
Metal: Gold tone

title: Molten Solitaire Pendant
intro: A stone in poured gold. One round clear cubic zirconia of about 8mm sits deep inside an irregular frame of polished gold tone that ripples like molten metal, about 12mm across, on a fine cable chain.
tip: Pair it with the Molten Bloom Hoops or the Molten Wave Ear Cuff.
details: Pendant: Approximately 12mm, rippled molten frame
Stone: Round clear cubic zirconia, approximately 8mm
Chain: Fine cable chain
Length: Approximately 45cm (to confirm)
Metal: Gold tone

title: Petite Pear Solitaire Necklace
intro: One small clear drop. A pear cut cubic zirconia of about 7 x 10mm hangs point up in fine gold tone claws from a tiny bead bail, on a fine cable chain.
tip: The everyday drop: wear it daily, or layer it under a longer chain.
details: Stone: Pear cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 7 x 10mm, in a claw setting
Bail: Small round bead
Chain: Fine cable chain
Length: Approximately 45cm (to confirm)
Metal: Gold tone

title: Petite Fleur Y Necklace
intro: A tiny flower and a fine drop. Five small round clear cubic zirconia form a flower about 6mm across where the chain meets at the front, and a single fine chain falls about 5cm below it, ending in a small polished gold tone flower.
tip: Wear it with a deep V or an open collar, so the drop runs straight.
details: Flower: Approximately 6mm, five small round clear cubic zirconia around a gold tone centre
Drop: Fine chain, approximately 5cm, with a small gold tone flower charm
Chain: Fine cable chain
Length: Approximately 42cm (to confirm)
Metal: Gold tone

title: Asscher Solitaire Pendant
intro: One octagon of light. A clear Asscher cut cubic zirconia of about 9mm, its corners clipped into an octagon and its step facets deep like a hall of mirrors, sits in fine gold tone claws below a ridged bail, on a fine curb chain.
tip: Pair it with the Asscher Solitaire Ring.
details: Stone: Asscher cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 9mm, in a claw setting
Bail: Polished, with a single ridge
Chain: Fine curb chain with a lobster clasp and extender
Length: Approximately 42cm plus the extender (to confirm)
Metal: Gold tone

title: Cushion Bezel Pendant
intro: A small square of light. A cushion cut clear cubic zirconia of about 6mm sits in a smooth, thick gold tone bezel about 8mm across, hanging from a small round bail on a fine snake chain.
tip: Wear it daily; it sits close at the collarbone.
details: Stone: Cushion cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 6mm
Setting: Smooth bezel, approximately 8mm
Chain: Fine round snake chain with a lobster clasp and extender
Length: Approximately 42cm plus the extender (to confirm)
Metal: Gold tone

title: Herringbone Teardrop Necklace
intro: A polished V and one clear drop. A flat herringbone chain about 3mm wide turns into two smooth gold tone bars that meet in a V at the front, and a pear cut clear cubic zirconia of about 8 x 11mm hangs point up from the point of the V.
tip: Wear it alone with a white top or a deep neckline.
details: Chain: Flat herringbone chain, approximately 3mm wide
Front: Two polished bars, approximately 15mm each, meeting in a V
Drop: Pear cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 8 x 11mm, hanging point up in a claw setting
Length: Approximately 45cm (to confirm)
Material: 316L stainless steel with a PVD gold tone finish, as labelled by the supplier
note: Held at review on 31 Oct; the piece in stock has a polished V at the front, which the earlier photos lacked.

title: Heart Solitaire Huggies
intro: A heart below a plain hoop. Each earring is a smooth, polished gold tone huggie of about 15mm with a heart cut clear cubic zirconia of about 6.5mm hanging below it in a closed bezel.
tip: Every day, or with a stud in a second piercing.
details: Hoop: Plain polished huggie, approximately 15mm, hinged snap closure
Drop: Heart cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 6.5mm, in a closed bezel
Sold as: One pair
Material: Stainless steel, as on the supplier's card
note: The stock in hand has a plain hoop and a bezel heart; the 1 Nov photos showed a pave hoop and a claw-set heart.

title: Bow and Heart Gift Set
intro: A bow of hearts, and a heart of gold. Each earring is a bow of two heart cut clear cubic zirconia with a heart in a fine pave halo hanging below it, and the necklace carries a polished puffed gold tone heart beside three small clear stones on a fine cable chain.
tip: Give the set; wear the earrings alone on the days after.
details: Set: One necklace and one pair of drop earrings
Earrings: A bow of two heart cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 6mm each, with a pave halo heart drop; approximately 14mm long, stud fitting
Necklace: A polished puffed heart, approximately 7mm, beside three small round clear cubic zirconia
Chain: Fine cable chain with a lobster clasp and extender
Length: Approximately 42cm plus the extender (to confirm)
Material: Stainless steel, as on the supplier's card
note: Photos 5 and 6: the earrings' bow is two heart cut stones, and the necklace is a gold heart with three stones; the 1 Nov photos showed pave bows and halo hearts.
